turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Operation?}

    B -->|ASSAY| C[Read document]
    C --> D[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    D --> E[Compress to residue]
    E --> F[Name evaporated content]
    F --> G[Locate operative sentence]
    G --> H[Report ratio, erosion direction, and missing rough edge]
    H --> I[Return finding]
    I --> J[Stop]

    B -->|PROVIDE| K{Mode stated or inferable?}
    K -->|No| L[Ask for mode]
    L --> K
    K -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| M[Check Audience, Scope, Format, and Path]

    M -->|Gaps| N{Number of gaps}
    N -->|1 to 3| O[Ask one question]
    N -->|4 or more| P[Ask three largest questions]
    P --> Q[State assumptions for remaining gaps]
    O --> R[Wait for answer]
    Q --> R
    R --> M

    M -->|Pass| S[Compress prompt]
    S --> T{Cut removed specification?}
    T -->|Yes| U[Name failure and restore last version]
    U --> S
    T -->|No| V{Two empty cuts in sequence?}
    V -->|No| W{Floor still passes?}
    W -->|No| X[Return last passing version]
    W -->|Yes| S
    X --> Y[Present contract]
    V -->|Yes| Y

    Y --> Z{Freeze this contract and execute?}
    Z -->|Keep negotiating| S
    Z -->|Valid human freeze| AA{Execution tools available?}
    Z -->|Invalid freeze| S
    AA -->|No| AB[Keep gate closed]
    AA -->|Yes| AC[Freeze contract and execute]
    AC --> AD{Result}
    AD -->|Success| AE[Complete]
    AD -->|Floor failure| AF[Name failed item and reopen contract]
    AF --> S
```
